name: Columbia Heights Rezoning
intro: The former Squibb and Watchtower complex at the north end of Brooklyn Heights. The owner wants to rezone it from manufacturing to mixed use so the two big buildings can be partly converted to apartments and enlarged.

status.headline: The formal ULURP clock has not started
paragraphs: The application is filed with City Planning [[zap]]. The environmental review is underway, and the public scoping meeting took place on March 12, 2026 [[scopenotice]]. The next step is DCP issuing the Final Scope of Work, which its system targets for Nov 16–26, 2026 [[zap]]. After that, the applicant prepares the Draft EIS. Once City Planning certifies the application as complete, the 7-month ULURP clock starts with Community Board 2 [[ulurp]].

No ULURP hearing or vote has been scheduled. Community Board 2, the Borough President, the City Planning Commission and the City Council have all recorded nothing yet [[zap]]. The only CPC date in DCP's system is a review session listed for May 17, 2027 [[zap]]. That's probably the pre-certification review, which would put certification in late spring 2027.

Scoping comments aren't public yet. DCP publishes them, with its responses, in the Final Scope [[ds]]. Press coverage in March found residents supportive of housing but worried about the added height. Council Member Restler said he expects "a good solution" and stressed protecting Brooklyn Bridge views from the Promenade [[ny1]].

requests.title: Actions and approvals
rows: Changes the 25 Columbia Heights block from M2-1 to M1-5A/R10A and the 30–58 block from M2-1 to M1-5A/R8A [[pd]]. Housing is not allowed under the current zoning; it would be after the change [[zct]].

Creates a new Special Mixed Use District (ZR 123-90; labeled MX-29 in the project description [[pd]] and MX-26 in the comparison table [[zct]]). Also maps a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area (Appendix F), which sets the 25% affordable requirement [[pd]].
Not ULURP, but reviewed alongside the map change (CB, BP, CPC, Council) [[ulurp]]

A Type I action needing a full EIS, with CPC as lead agency [[posdec]]. The scope covers socioeconomics, community facilities, open space, shadows, historic resources, urban design, transportation, air quality, noise, hazardous materials and construction [[ds]].
DEIS hearing is held with the CPC hearing [[ds]]
Checks the project against the city's Waterfront Revitalization Program. The site is in FEMA flood zone A [[zap]].
The skybridge (11A, current term from Jul 1, 2018) would be removed. The applicant plans to renew the consent for the utility tunnel (11B) [[pd]].

watch.p: The application only says "dwelling units" [[pd]]. Press reports call them rentals [[eagle]]. Tenure isn't a zoning matter, so the ULURP record may never settle it. The MIH affordable units would be permanently affordable either way.

DCP's project summary still says 640 units and 113,000 sf of commercial space [[zap]]. The Feb 2026 project description says 661 units, and its floor areas add up to about 180,000 sf of commercial space [[pd]]. Check which figures the Final Scope and DEIS use.

Squibb Park, Hillside Dog Park, Harry Chapin Playground and Brooklyn Bridge Park sit right next to the site [[pd]]. The EIS will study shadow and open-space effects in detail [[ds]]. These are likely to be the main topics at CB2.

The site is outside the Brooklyn Heights and Fulton Ferry historic districts, so it doesn't need Landmarks approval. It does sit between them [[pd]]. Removing the skybridge would open up views of the bridges [[pd]]. The 17-story addition at 25 would be new in the skyline.
DOT expects to start BQE work next to the site in 2029 [[pd]], the same year as the project's build year [[ds]]. Expect questions about construction staging and traffic. See the BQE tab.
Watchtower sought a rezoning here in 1988 (C 840362 ZMK) for a 19-story dorm. CPC approved it, but the Board of Estimate denied it. The block has been M2-1 since 1961 [[pd]].

footer: Estimated dates use the City Charter §197-c clocks (CB 60 days, BP 30, CPC 60, Council 50, Mayor 5) counted from an assumed certification date [[ulurp]]. They are not official.
